description: Paired between-architecture comparisons within disease; leaf-level; test partition.

bootstrap.pairing: one index matrix per disease (drawn in order rust, leaf spot), shared by all models, pairs and metrics

sign_convention: difference = first model minus second model; dMAE<0 and d|bias|<0 favour the first model; dQWK>0 and dAccuracy>0 favour the first model
mcnemar: exact two-sided binomial test on discordant leaves (grade correct vs wrong); Holm across the three pairs within disease and reference standard
wilson: Wilson score interval, two-sided 95%, no continuity correction
paired_accuracy_interval: Tango (1998) asymptotic score interval (primary for dAccuracy); Newcombe (1998) method 10 as cross-check; percentile bootstrap also given
equivalence_note: No equivalence or non-inferiority margin was pre-specified. 'tost_margin_needed' is the smallest symmetric margin a TOST at alpha=0.05 (90% CI inside +/-margin) would accept; descriptive only. For d_accuracy (and d_accuracy_mask_derived) it comes from the Tango score 90% interval ('tango_score_ci90'), because the 90% percentile bootstrap is [0, 0] or has a bound pinned at 0 for every pair and would understate the margin. For other metrics it comes from the 90% percentile interval and is null when that interval has a bound pinned at exactly 0 (all d_qwk here); see 'tost_margin_basis'.
comparison_note: All comparisons are between the published trained models. Training protocols differed (revision brief facts 3-4: the published CNNs used photometric jitter p=0.8 and, for rust, at most 30 epochs, patience 12 and FP-penalised model selection; SegFormer-B5 used geometric augmentation only, up to 60 epochs, patience 15). The differences are therefore not controlled architecture effects (see revision brief item 11 for matched-protocol rust retraining).
coverage_note: Healthy rust-pack test leaves: 21 present locally (EARTH site, collected 2026-06-12/15/22); the paper used 54. Healthy leaves enter only the separate G0-recall rows.
